_comment: Token prices in USD per 1,000,000 tokens, keyed by model id.
DELIBERATELY UNSET. Provider pricing changes and varies by tier, so these
are operator-supplied rather than hardcoded: a stale constant compiled into
the agent would silently produce wrong cost figures in BENCHMARK.md.
Until a model is priced here, the agent reports token counts (which are
measured and real) and reports cost as null with reason 'unpriced'.
It never estimates a dollar figure it cannot substantiate.
To enable cost reporting, fill in the rates from the current pricing page
